_meta.description: Partner / vendor catalog used to build the Snowflake Summit dashboard.
_meta.data_note: STARTER / ILLUSTRATIVE DATA. These are real companies in the Snowflake partner ecosystem, but the per-vendor attributes (tier, booth, funding, g2_rating, employees) are approximate and meant as a working seed. Replace this file with your authoritative partner-vendors export (same field names) and re-run build.py to regenerate the dashboard.

schema.name: string
schema.funding_m: approx total funding in USD millions, or null if public/large-cap
schema.native_app: bool - has a Snowflake Native App / deep integration
schema.ai_focus: bool - core product is AI/ML oriented
schema.partner_of_year: bool - has won a Snowflake Partner of the Year award
